evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/l/c carries plugin name 'Menu Entry Swapper' and descriptor text 'Change the default option that is displayed when hovering over objects'.
The plugin consumes MenuHover/MenuOpened events, tracks NPC/item/object swap maps and rewrites default menu entries using its injected MenuEntrySwapperConfig.
RuneLite MenuEntrySwapperPlugin preserves the exact plugin name and exact distinctive descriptor text together with the same NPC/inventory/items/objects domain.

proposals.note: Source-proven RuneLite plugin identity; exact-v308 menu behavior remains primary authority.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/l/b is the menuentryswapper config interface and preserves Item Swaps, NPC Swaps, item left-click customization and shift-click customization controls.

RuneLite MenuEntrySwapperConfig uses config group 'menuentryswapper' and preserves the same distinctive descriptions including 'Allows customization of left-clicks on NPCs' and item/shift-click customization vocabulary.
The only live sibling consumer rs/s/l/c injects this interface and carries the Menu Entry Swapper plugin descriptor.
